steps.content: In an obscure office, a man is sitting by the window alone. A black raven lands on the arm of his chair, glances at the letter in his hand, and suddenly cries out.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw... Caw... News from the ruins of the <color=#fb9259>BR-004</color>. A good one, a bad one, and a hard-to-define one.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Which one would you like to hear first, my dear friend? Caw...
The man in the shadows remains silent. The black raven hops and tilts its head, then continues talking.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Alright. I'll start with my favorite, the good one. Blue treasures are coming out of the remains of BR-004 after six months. Not much, but they are there.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: You were right, friend. Dark clouds have silver linings. And Syndicate has never lost hope.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: <size=30>The bad news is that the filth that came out of nowhere still exists. Strange things are happening in the dead ring,  and a calamity simmers its comeback. Some soldiers stationed there were wounded, so the bigwigs sent in a <color=#fb9259>big gun</color> to investigate in secret.</size>

steps.speaker: Man in the Shadow
steps.content: ...Six months ago, you said the owner of BR-004 was destroyed. That ring has been confirmed silent and unlikely to be active again.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw... Caw... I did, and it was true. But it has been awakened by someone else. It's not the only Black Ring in Syndicate, remember? Eight years ago, in the pit, remember?
The lights flicker in the silent room. The items are swept off the table, and an oil lamp shatters into a puddle of flames, startling the raven.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw... Calm down, friend. Don't get overwhelmed by the darkness from the past. You have sworn to look for the light. And the last and most important news. Here it is...

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: The secret investigator is a hidden shepherd with Mania shackles from a secret institution.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: It's the one who led the Legion into the trap, controlled the Sinners, and tore the Black Ring—their hero... will come back to Syndicate today.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: You have been waiting for this for a long time, right? What do you want me to do? And what will you do?

steps.speaker: Man in the Shadow
steps.content: ...Raye.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Man in the Shadow
steps.content: Can you quit talking like that when delivering a message? It hurts my ears. You sounded quite normal the last time we met.
The raven crows with laughter and flaps its wings. Its fully stretched body explodes into black ink, splashing on the man's hand and the letter he's holding.
The man picks up the paper and takes a look, <color=#fb9259>BR-004</color>, <color=#fb9259>Legion</color>, <color=#fb9259>Zoya</color>, <color=#fb9259>Earl</color>, <color=#fb9259>FAC</color>...
He throws the letter into the flames on the floor. The fire reflects on the window, and through the reflection, he looks outside.

<size=30>The dawn hasn't fallen yet. The optical camouflage fluctuates, occasionally revealing the Black Ring of DisSea from inside the barrier, but it soon disappears like a mirage. The distant Eastside is still the glory of humanity for its hustle and prosperity.</size>
But that prosperity is far too distant. The vast expanse of land extending silently in front of him is the gray West District factories, his hometown where it has nothing left.

steps.speaker: Man in the Shadow
steps.content: ...I'll find out if he's a friend or foe.
steps.female_content: ...I'll find out if she's a friend or foe.

steps.speaker: Man in the Shadow
steps.content: The fire will come. This time... it won't be extinguished.
